# TodoManager

> **File:** `services/apps/TodoManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

The todo list: one list for every widget and module, kept in $XDG_DATA_HOME/axiom/todo.json ({ version, items }: TodoItems' shape), written atomically and watched, so an edit made elsewhere shows at once. While the file can't be read (a hand edit half done), nothing is written over it. Never read or written in the greeter. axiom ipc todo add "Buy milk"

### Properties

- `items` (readonly var): Every item, in order (see TodoItems)
- `openCount` (readonly int)
- `loaded` (readonly bool)
- `path` (readonly string)
- `shownItems` (readonly var): What a list shows (TodoItems.shown, with Todo.showCompleted)

### Functions

- `add(text)`: Adds an open item; its uid, or "" for an empty text (or a list that can't be written now)
- `toggle(uid, done)`: Done ↔ open (`done` given: sets it)
- `rename(uid, text)`
- `remove(uid)`
- `move(uid, index)`: To `index` in `items`
- `clearCompleted()`
- `find(uid)`
